messages:
jamie: Triage idea: add a 'spillway' layer before the continuous batcher to handle overloads. options: preemptible microbatches, slow lanes, or model-variant fallback. objective: keep p99 latency SLOs and avoid hard failures.

maria: Important: KV cache interactions. aggressive eviction will tank hit rates and cost rises.

arjun: Tradeoffs: spill lowers batching efficiency -> higher per-token cost. also complicates affinity/order guarantees. propose adding a tiny admission hint: service_class + spill_hint so decisions are deterministic.

sasha: Ops asks for metrics: spill_rate, kv_miss_after_spill, fallback_latency, fallback_quality_delta. Need a compact operator config proto.

jamie: Proto sketch: `spillway_config { threshold_ms: 120 preemptible_capacity: 0.15 degrade_policy: \"model_fallback\" kv_eviction_budget_tokens: 5000 }`

kevin: Model fallback is risky for quality-sensitive workloads. Gate with eval hooks and enable only for low-criticality tenants. Auto-rollback if eval drops >2 pts.

maria: If a tenant's batch is split across lanes we must preserve per-request KV affinity or regeneration cost explodes.

arjun: Mitigation: preemptible microbatches carry a lightweight KV shadow pointer to main cache; reattachment within ~50ms avoids cold fetch.

sasha: Rollout: feature-flag + per-tenant tunables + Console telemetry card + API for spill_revocation to recall spilled requests to fast-path if capacity frees.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for eng-runtime/spillway-canary on Tue 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC :rocket:

jamie: Plan: implement admission header + telemetry + POC that routes to slow-lane. Measure p99 delta vs token cost. Volunteers: @arjun POC, @sasha metrics, @kevin eval gating.

kevin: I'll mock eval hooks and a synthetic quality monitor.

maria: Streaming edge: spilled streaming requests must keep the stream alive or provide graceful placeholders. Long blanks are awful UX.

arjun: Keep streaming in slow-lane with smaller flush sizes to keep SSE/chunks alive; add server-side deadlines and per-route policies.

sasha: Console card asked: "spillway - p50/p95/p99, kv_miss_after_spill, fallback_quality_delta". Also billing telemetry for token delta.

jamie: Default degrade_policy suggestion: "slow_lane" (safe). model_fallback opt-in. Add alert: spill_rate >20% sustained for 5m -> page eng-runtime.

eng-infra: Please loop us in early if you touch KV eviction paths; we have regression test scripts and perf caveats.

sasha: Final note: keep admission envelope minimal. Suggest headers: `x-spill-class: conservative|best_effort` and `x-spill-allow-fallback: true|false`.

jamie: I'll draft RFC covering admission shape, telemetry, proto sketch, safe defaults, and rollout checklist. Schedule sync Fri. Assigning action items in the RFC."
